“Coffee, connection & a little parenting wisdom. 🤎
At UMI, our Coffee Morning is a space to pause, reflect and grow together. This time, we explored “A Secure Base”—learning when to step in, when to step back, and how simply being there can give our little ones the confidence to explore. 🌱✨
Because parenting isn’t about being perfect; it’s about being present. ❤️

At UMI, we explored how beavers use their sharp, continuously growing teeth to gnaw on wood and twigs, building sturdy homes in the wild! Bringing their creations to life on the light table was pure magic 
stones, twigs, and grass transformed into cozy animal shelters, built by little hands and big imaginations.

Pure joy, warm hugs, and priceless smiles made our Grandparents Day celebration truly unforgettable. Seeing our favorite people fill the room with love, laughter, and cherished stories reminded us of what matters most. We’re so grateful for every laugh, dance, and sweet connection shared today!

“Guess How Much I Love You” by Sam McBratney, illustrated by Anita Jeram.
At UMI, this is one we return to again and again …….a gentle read-aloud that opens up big conversations about love, comparison, and how some things (like love) can’t really be measured at all.
